tasks.title: Lock the navigation taxonomy and concept ownership map
tasks.summary: Turn the proposal taxonomy into the local UI model: Home, Workflow, Evidence, and System groups, with one owner page for each migration concept.
notes: Home is the default landing page and is not a peer workflow section.
Prepare owns profile and role inputs; Connect owns device and trust state; Move owns transfer and sync execution; Verify & Repair owns verification, drift, reconcile, and prune.
Evidence Vault remains the raw durable artifact owner.
Implemented in AppSection.homeSection, AppSection.sidebarGroups, topLevelNavigationSections, ownerSection, and WorkbenchNavigationTests.

tasks.title: Separate Home from grouped workflow navigation
tasks.summary: Refactor the sidebar so Control Room/Home is visually independent from workflow sections while preserving default selection and role-aware availability.
notes: Replace the flat Sections list with explicit navigation groups.
Keep selectedSection defaulting to the home/control room surface.
Add model-level tests if the grouping can be represented without fragile view inspection.
ContentView now renders Home outside the grouped Workflow/Evidence/System navigation cards instead of iterating AppSection.allCases.

tasks.title: Merge overlapping top-level pages into owner pages
tasks.summary: Collapse Devices plus Pairing into Connect, Transfer plus Sync into Move, and Verification plus Drift Review into Verify & Repair without deleting underlying wired controls.
notes: Use segmented controls or local tabs inside owner pages where modes still need separation.
Do not change CLI behavior or profile-backed command contracts in this task.
Old concepts should remain reachable through the merged owner pages during the first pass.
ContentView now routes Pairing through Connect, Sync through Move, and Drift Review through Verify & Repair owner surfaces with mode strips.

tasks.title: Reduce low-density explanatory UI into icon and detail-on-demand patterns
tasks.summary: Replace repeated subtitles and long status explanations with icon-first status rows, hover/help affordances, and detail drawers while keeping blocking safety text visible.
notes: Use SF Symbols already present in the app style.
Do not hide actionable failure reasons behind hover only.
Raw command lines and evidence paths should move to explicit detail surfaces or Evidence Vault links.
Sidebar non-available states now use icon-only status affordances with hover help; owner mode strip copy is shorter while blocking safety text remains visible.

tasks.title: Validate the simplified workbench shell
tasks.summary: Run Swift tests and a manual app smoke to prove the simplified shell opens correctly, preserves evidence access, and does not overclaim migration capability.

last_gate_commands.command: swift run --package-path macos SuperMoverApp launch smoke, terminated after it stayed running for 4s

notes: Expected checks include targeted Swift tests, go tests if shared contracts change, git diff --check, and an app launch smoke.
Final docs must keep design proposal, wired UI behavior, and roadmap capability separate.
Model tests, build, diff check, and a 4s app launch smoke passed.
